newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan buys 54,000 tonnes U.S. corn at tender.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan buys 54,000 tonnes U.S. corn at tender.

text.p: Taiwan's CK Group of importers on Tuesday bought one 54,000-tonne shipment of U.S. corn from Cargill at a tender, local traders said.
The corn was bought 87.99 U.S. cents over Chicago March futures, they said.
The shipment was slated for January 17-31 delivery from the U.S. Gulf or February 1-15 from the Pacific Northwest, traders said.
The CK Group comprises Chia Hsin Flour Feed and Vegetable Oil Corp and some buyers from Taiwan's southern port city of Kaohsiung.
